rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a high-quality hatching/expanded blastocyst and appropriately addresses ICM, TE, and zona thinning/breaching. Minor limitation is some image-specific localization/detail may be overconfident without stronger visual confirmation.
Strong integration of maternal age, AMH, low MII yield, tubal factor diagnosis, endometrial thickness, lifestyle, and paternal age/sperm factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, linking morphology, age-related euploidy, and cycle characteristics to prognosis. Minor issue is somewhat speculative attribution of low maturation to trigger/protocol and stress effects on implantation.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: SET for a good-quality day-5 blastocyst, attention to luteal support, and review of stimulation/trigger strategy. Slight downgrade for speculative emphasis on stress and for presenting PGT-A discussion somewhat broadly rather than tightly guideline-framed for this exact scenario.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and concrete future-cycle options, including SET, luteal support, protocol/trigger review, sperm DNA fragmentation testing, and embryo banking considerations.
